test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: If the diameter of a sphere is reduced to its half, then the volume would be:

options.text: increased by (1)/(4) of the former volume
reduced by (1)/(4) of the former volume
increased by (1)/(8) of the former volume
reduced by (1)/(8) of the former volume

solution:
**Given:**

Initial diameter = D

New diameter = D/2

**Formula Used:**

The volume of sphere: V = (4/3)πr³

**Calculation**

Initial radius r = D/2 New radius = (D/2)/2 = D/4

Initial volume V_i = (4/3)π(D/2)³

New volume V_n = (4/3)π(D/4)³

⇒ V_n = (4/3)π[(D/4)³]

⇒ (4/3)π[(1/8)(D/2)³]

⇒ (1/8) × (4/3)π(D/2)³ = 1/8 × V_i

**New volume = 1/8 of initial volume.**
